box.note: too few alerts in the 13 days after 2026-11-15; the box shows the latest days with enough alerts

window_choice.rule: start on one of the latest days with enough alerts (last 45 days); any whole number of hours up to 360 (15 days)

hourly.covers: from the first day of the box up to now
hourly.delay_note: delay_median_s: median time from the middle of the exposure to the alert's publication time as recorded by Pitt-Google

alerce.counted_by: hour of the object's latest detection

tonight.note: Babamul's live count; a night runs 15:00 to 15:00 UTC; delay = from Babamul receiving an alert to having processed it

pairs.how_to_recount: keep the pairs with separation <= x and time gap <= t; Set B = Set A objects + the objects outside Set A that appear in a kept pair

now.message: The Sun is just below the horizon at the Rubin Observatory (twilight); the sky is dark enough to observe from about 29 Nov 00:31 UTC.

stream.note: Fink's live LSST topics; each topic is a selection of alerts, so these are messages, not all alerts. Newest message: within 10 min / 1 h / 6 h / 1 d / 7 d, or null if none in 7 days

rubin_board.label: Rubin alert production (Grafana)
rubin_board.note: read from the board's own panels: 'Alerts in plotting interval' summed over 24 h, and how many of the alert distribution servers report up

states.daytime: Sun above the horizon at the observatory
states.twilight: Sun below the horizon but above -12 degrees
states.off: dark at the observatory and no alert in the last hour

made_by: the main run; refreshed with every main run
